mathematics.assertion_tested: Finite-difference BdG scattering on analytic GP interface; flux conservation, normal-incidence mesh refinement and finite-domain refinement.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: complex float64 sparse boundary-value linear systems
mathematics.conventions: Leading one-field GP wall; E relative to chemical potential; normal current includes both Bogoliubov components; imposed external potential.
non_claims: No full two-field scattering or physical trap interaction.
All-angle open channel does not imply nonreflecting interface.
Not a spherical transport or global pair-gain stability calculation.
